description: In the Webots robot simulator, change the simulation time step from 32 to 64 milliseconds via the WorldInfo node, then save the world to a new file.

natural_language.prompt: In the Webots robot simulator that is currently open, you need to modify the simulation time step. In the scene tree on the left side of the window, click on the 'WorldInfo' node to expand it. Find the 'basicTimeStep' field which is currently set to 32. Click on it and change the value to 64 milliseconds in the field editor panel that appears below the scene tree. After making the change, save the world file using File > Save World As... and save it to /home/ga/Desktop/modified_soccer.wbt.
